display_title: A Man Who Can See Libido
description:
Mr. Song Mingu has extraordinary abilities. He can see people's libido. That helps him to earn money, working as a hostess with women.   
One day he saves a girl from the gangs. Unexpectedly, the girl is killed in the next few days. Mingu is the main suspect. Will his abilities help him to avoid jail?
